content:
Answers for teams evaluating LoreFoundry.

What is LoreFoundry?

LoreFoundry is a workspace for organizing your game world, planning story content, and keeping canon consistent with continuity checks. LoreFoundry Core can suggest starting points, but every decision stays with your team.

What is LoreFoundry Core?

LoreFoundry Core is the AI system within LoreFoundry.

Do I need experience with AI tools?

No. You can outline quests, characters, and places manually. When you want a faster starting point, enable LoreFoundry Core and edit any suggestion before it becomes canon.

Which engines are supported?

Export tooling is in development. Today you can capture structured lore, quests, and events. We will publish engine-ready pipelines as soon as they are stable.

Who can join LoreFoundry?

Anyone building narrative worlds can sign up now. Studio onboarding and advanced role controls are available on request.

Does LoreFoundry replace writers?

No. Your team reviews every change and decides what becomes canon.

Can we import our lore?

Yes. Upload documents or use bulk import so Core references your canon.

How is data kept safe?

Role controls and audits keep projects private. Continuity rules stay inside your team.

Still curious? info@lorefoundry.io
